title: Model-based and model-free control in people: the two-step task
summary: The two-step task's transition structure; stay probabilities by previous reward and transition type as the model-independent measure; a hybrid model weighting model-based and model-free values; per-subject maximum-likelihood estimation and model comparison.

preparation.description: Read the participants and task section of Daw et al. (2011).
Read the Behavior section: the task logic and the predictions after a rare transition.
Study Figure 2: stay probabilities by reward and transition, predictions and data.
Read the computational model of behaviour: the hybrid weighted by w.
